summary: Write g − embedH(h) = embedH(h)(w − 1) with w = embedH(h)⁻¹g ∈ 𝖴; the trace of M·embedH(h)·(w − 1) vanishes term by term because M·embedH(h) is block upper triangular and w − 1 is strictly block upper triangular.

steps.claim: g − embedH(h) = embedH(h)·(embedH(h)⁻¹g − 1), so the trace is tr((M·embedH(h))·(w − 1)) with w = embedH(h)⁻¹g, which lies in 𝖴 (the defining condition of besselGraph(𝔰)).

steps.lean:
exact sum_eq_zero fun i _ ↦ sum_eq_zero fun j _ ↦ mul_eq_zero.2 ((lt_or_ge ..).imp (h.mul (by
    simp; lia) ·) (sub_eq_zero.2 ∘ mem_besselU.1 s.2 j i))
steps.claim: tr((M·embedH(h))(w − 1)) = Σ_{i,j}(M·embedH(h))_ij(w − 1)_ji and each term is 0: if level(j) < level(i), (M·embedH(h))_ij = 0 since M is block upper triangular and embedH(h) is block diagonal for the levels (it acts only on X₀, inside the middle level); otherwise level(i) ≤ level(j) and (w − 1)_ji = 0 because w ∈ 𝖴.
